legend.pass: every test of the row is green in the current run, or the check an agent made by hand was recorded as passed
legend.bug: a product defect; the bug record is named beside it
legend.wait: handed to a person - planned manual, automated where the factory has no access, or an expected value nobody confirmed yet (it waits for your answer)
legend.blocked: the stand stops the test before its own checks, or the code critic rejected the test and has not reviewed the change
legend.not run: no green or red result of the current run is recorded for it; the basis says what the run recorded, if anything
legend.unreachable: the scenario cannot occur in the product as it is built
legend.deferred: a person's recorded decision put it aside
legend.not planned: a register requirement no plan row plans: none names it, or its plan row says it cannot be verified
